name: set_env
description: Sets a configuration value (secret or public env var) for an app. The key must already be one Utplava detected as needed from the app's own source code — this tool cannot be used to invent arbitrary new configuration keys, which is a deliberate security boundary, not a current limitation to be lifted later.

key.description: Must exactly match a key already listed in app_env_requirements for this app (surfaced via deploy's missingConfig or get_status). Keys not already detected are rejected with ENV_KEY_NOT_APPROVED — set_env cannot be used to configure something the platform never asked for.

errors.note: Key isn't a valid environment variable name shape.
Key isn't in this app's detected requirements — the core security boundary this tool enforces. Not retryable; the agent should not attempt a different key name to work around it.
e.g. DATABASE_URL when Utplava manages the database — nothing for the agent or customer to set.
